title: White House alarmed by Lutnick not blacklisting Nvidia-linked firm
summary: CNN reports that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent clashed with Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick over Commerce's failure to put Megaspeed, a Singapore-based buyer of more than $4 billion in Nvidia chips, on the entity list despite suspicions it routed advanced processors to China. The pressure grew after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted an affair with a former Megaspeed executive suspected by US intelligence of Chinese links, prompting lawmakers in both parties to demand testimony and investigations. Senator Richard Blumenthal then discusses the national security stakes and possible conflicts of interest, before the piece turns to questions about political donations and how the Justice Department is responding.
focus: Shadow the opening stretch where the reporter lays out the Treasury-versus-Commerce dispute and what the entity list does, then Blumenthal's measured answer on national security risks, which is a good model for calm, structured argument under pressure.
